title: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
slides: Can Anthropic power the AI boom without breaking?
It's burning gas to feed its own data centers.
The gas isn't for Anthropic's models alone.
Your energy bills may rise as AI demand grows.
Check your next power bill — AI is in it.
thread_text:
1. The AI boom's hidden fuel

Anthropic is burning natural gas to power its data centers, and the gas isn't just for its own models.

2. Not just for Anthropic

The gas also supplies other AI companies, making the energy demand far larger than one firm's footprint.

3. Your bill is next

As AI demand grows, utilities are passing costs to consumers—your energy bills may rise.

4. The grid strain

Data centers are competing with homes and businesses for power, and the squeeze is just beginning.

5. Check your power bill

Look at the supply charge on your next bill—does it mention data centers? If not, ask your utility why.

instagram.caption:
Natural gas is being burned to keep AI data centers running — and not just Anthropic's own models.

The gas also supplies other AI companies, so the energy demand is bigger than one firm's footprint. 🔥

As demand grows, utilities pass costs to consumers, and data centers now compete with homes and businesses for power.

If you publish or create with AI tools, the infrastructure behind them is drawing from the same grid you pay for. ⚡

Check the supply charge on your next bill — does it mention data centers? If not, ask your utility why. 📄
